# Noa Court

> Noa Court is a testnet NEAR resolution service for prediction markets and other contracts. Agents draft a canonical ResolutionSpec, sample and preflight evidence with MCP, then a creator signs market transactions or a consumer requests a generic verdict. The Court contract stores specs and receipts, while the resolver fetches, extracts, and decides through OutLayer. The normal keeper only calls permissionless lifecycle methods. Testnet fallback receipts have `tee: false`; inspect each receipt.

MCP (stateless Streamable HTTP, no auth, rate limited): https://noacourtmcp.junstudio.xyz/mcp
Health: https://noacourtmcp.junstudio.xyz/healthz

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/cuongdcdev/noacourt/blob/main/README.md): start here, architecture and quick try.
- [Integration guide](https://github.com/cuongdcdev/noacourt/blob/main/docs/INTEGRATE.md): generic requests, callbacks, Noa links, and MCP use.
- [ResolutionSpec and Verdict reference](https://github.com/cuongdcdev/noacourt/blob/main/docs/SPEC.md): source grammar, lint, decisions, and examples.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/cuongdcdev/noacourt/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): component contracts and trust split.
- [E2E results](https://github.com/cuongdcdev/noacourt/blob/main/E2E_RESULTS.md): all first-wave scenarios passed on testnet, with receipts and independent checks.
- [Court contract interface](https://github.com/cuongdcdev/noacourt/blob/main/contracts/court/README.md): exact arguments, gas, deposits, and states.

## Testnet IDs

- Court: `ai-resolver.noamarket.testnet`
- Noa market: `v3.noamarket.testnet`
- NPOINT token (18 decimals): `point.noamarket.testnet`
- OutLayer: `outlayer.testnet`, project `court-ops.noamarket.testnet/court-resolver`
- Court trigger calls: current OutLayer gas 200 TGas and execution limit 150 seconds; attach 300 TGas prepaid to `trigger` or `trigger_request` (minimum 265 TGas).
- Retry defaults: five attempts every three minutes. Noa's resolution deadline must extend at least five more minutes beyond `observation.at + max_attempts × retry.every` (20 minutes with defaults); MCP computes the window.
- Pinned testnet resolver WASM SHA-256: `a8efb56c2f9fe31c2d857686d8b97179b15d8529a17984bfd31fc3f97ef6ce40`.

## Live evidence

- [A1 NEAR/USDT market 67](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/GtfMBy2GmCKKNLjBGbNm7Wppf3VTnZ8ydB92bMrBsDWs): resolved No on attempt 2; `tee: true`, submitted by OutLayer. Query Court `get_verdict({"id":"noa:67"})` for the stored receipt.
- [A8 RSS text-judge market 79](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/7JnWtdYRhPK5muTsUMC27Bg8nyhd8zBFNsTXhFGR28DL): 15-minute market with [Yes](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/7tNvi2wiReAeSjpUnRemSc1pHhqCzsjmHQqwBjr9toUj) and [No](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/2WKsnVpmNtyc2Rwd1sturW1HCntjTshMHEnhWRuVqaKP) bets; three jurors agreed on Yes in the TEE, `tee: true`; [finalized](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/5YESzkVyunsctNaPLPAEypvUonT9NHxfgH8qGyLHbdiL) and [claimed](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/FiUEfZpBLifAVS6r9d3bTfrWWwy1EQsKaniCENHFAkHN). Query `get_verdict({"id":"noa:79"})`.
- [A2–A4 markets 68–70](https://github.com/cuongdcdev/noacourt/blob/main/E2E_RESULTS.md): Flat, Up, and Yes respectively; all `tee: true`.
- [A6 market 76](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/BVuv2dZF6pWSLmY5JFYsSZ11rNdzCJ7wkEfoPQiLHm1A) and [A7 market 77](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/3NbFB8K2giB7yxxFyfUCcunjNWd2Etfw2kvn2xzPYREW): identity assertion failure and deleted source, respectively; both unresolvable and voided.
- [A8 market 73](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/HMUwVHVvegxTKANcMiGvToiynC32BdRid28q9A1skBNt), [A8n market 74](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/6vNnXRHexjnu1W699kqsLiSUnYgoDWuYiN9MFgnmTdFB), and [A9 market 75](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/D4zeVBo7kT8nTmtftaqf4HdFFK8NQZorLxJXQEyjDZYw): text evidence resolved Yes, No, and No respectively.
- [Generic `req:1`](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/EwTtoX8cAJBDUZWJrYnKchPdbnkQa8dnNJCuxnoXwPrZ): request followed by [keeper trigger](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/2FjTEHWCp6Um7Ro8NSgqGd4ukjz7i2qWAEsxJ1dtP9GA); resolved Yes, value `3.401`, attempt 2, `tee: true`.

The first-wave verdicts have `tee: true` and `submitted_by: "outlayer"`. A6–A9 fixtures are served at `https://noacourtmcp.junstudio.xyz/fixtures/<name>` and labelled `self_declared`; this host is not in the verified-source list.

One A8 rerun, [market 78](https://testnet.nearblocks.io/txns/9uRxS8JUQHuK9a4L9foWgYySgsHSX3nurkToArzkUgsx), had two OutLayer execution failures returning null. Court rejected them and the market was voided without a wrong outcome; the failure is under investigation.

## Agent instructions

Call `court_guide`, then `source_sample` for each source. Draft a spec with explicit timestamps, identity checks, fallback sources for price questions, and complete outcome mapping. Run `spec_lint`, `spec_simulate`, and `rules_render`; explain the sample values and rules to the creator. Use `market_create_link` only after the creator agrees to the market terms; the creator reviews and signs in their own wallet. For an existing market call `market_status` and `verdict_get`, and report the `tee` flag and evidence. For a non-Noa consumer, follow the generic `request_resolution` and callback guide. Noa core is closed source; Noa Court is the open-source component in this repository.
